name: Daniel Aronowitz
current_role: Assistant Secretary of Labor for the Employee Benefits Security Administration (since September 2025)
summary: Daniel Aronowitz runs the Employee Benefits Security Administration, which oversees private retirement and health plans. A labor lawyer turned fiduciary-liability insurer, he was president of Ullico Casualty and in 2011 founded Euclid Fiduciary (now Encore). Nominated in February 2025, he was confirmed on September 18, 2025, as part of a block vote, after telling senators the agency needed “a major turnaround.”
